howItWorks.title: One operating system, end to end
howItWorks.body: DAAS transforms raw business data into a complete decision workflow. Not a collection of dashboards — a coherent operating environment.

bringData.title: Bring your data
bringData.body: Upload files, connect Sheets, or attach a read-only database. Multi-table projects are first-class.

trustData.title: Trust the data
trustData.body: Schema discovery, relationship review, AI-assisted cleaning, validation, and reconciliation — every step observable and approvable.

decideConfidently.title: Decide with confidence
decideConfidently.body: Deterministic analytics, grounded insights, back-tested forecasts, churn intelligence, and exportable reports.

agentsSection.title: Six specialized agents, one workspace
agentsSection.body: Each agent is a specialized capability inside one unified environment — not six disconnected applications. They share project context, computed results, and your approval checkpoints.

features.title: From raw rows to grounded action
features.body: Eight product surfaces, one coherent system. Each is a workspace experience — not a grid of disconnected cards.

connectData.title: Connect your data
connectData.body: Upload CSV, TSV, Excel, JSON, Parquet. Connect Google Sheets or any PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MSSQL database. Multi-file and multi-table projects are first-class — never assume everything becomes one file.

dataPipeline.title: Data intelligence pipeline
dataPipeline.body: A guided, human-in-the-loop pipeline: source → profile → schema discovery → relationships → cleaning → validation → reconciliation → save. Every stage is observable and reviewable.

analytics.title: Analytics & visualization
analytics.body: A deterministic Executive Dashboard with KPI band, trend, category, customer mix, seasonality, and order-value distribution. Plus an AI Chart Studio that generates charts from natural language.

insights.title: Business insights
insights.body: Ranked findings with supporting evidence, business impact, confidence and grounding status. Why-it-happened explanations, risks, opportunities, and prioritized recommendations.

forecasting.title: Transparent forecasting
forecasting.body: Multi-model forecasts with a back-test leaderboard: Ensemble, Prophet, ETS, Holt-Winters, ARIMA, Theta, Linear, Moving Average, Naive. Confidence intervals, skill vs. naive, and “Why this forecast?” narrative.

marketing.title: Marketing intelligence
marketing.body: RFM segments with revenue contribution and recommended strategy. Churn-integrated marketing, grounded campaign builder, and an ad copy studio connected to real customer evidence.

churn.title: Churn prediction
churn.body: Score every customer by churn probability × customer spend = expected revenue at risk. AUC, precision, recall, validation method, and feature importance communicated clearly.

trust.title: Trust & grounded AI
trust.body: Every narrative is grounded in computed facts. Trust badges distinguish Grounded, Partially grounded, and Review recommended. Never fabricate confidence when validation is impossible.

humanLoop.title: Your approval, every step that matters
humanLoop.body: Consequential operations require explicit review. DAAS never silently commits relationship guesses, cleaning plans, reconciliation overrides, or AI-generated analysis actions.

relationshipReview.title: Relationship review
relationshipReview.body: High-confidence relationships auto-approve. Medium requires explicit OK. Low confidence triggers manual mapping.

cleaningPlans.title: Cleaning plans
cleaningPlans.body: Every cleaning step shows proposed action, reason, affected columns, estimated impact, and risk level — approve, edit, or reject.

reconciliationCheckpoint.title: Reconciliation checkpoint
reconciliationCheckpoint.body: Orphan rates before vs. after, sample unmatched values, and tolerance gates before saving trusted data.

aiActionApproval.title: AI action approval
aiActionApproval.body: AI-suggested campaigns, forecasts, and reports are previewable and approvable before any action is committed.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.body: Everything you need to understand how DAAS thinks about data, AI, and trust.

items.a: No. DAAS is a multi-agent Business Intelligence Operating System. AI exists contextually across the workspace — to explain KPIs, generate charts, interpret forecasts, and recommend actions — but never as the primary interface.

items.q: How does DAAS avoid inventing business numbers?
items.a: All metrics, KPIs, forecasts, churn probabilities, and customer segments are computed by deterministic analytics and ML engines. AI explains, interprets, and recommends. The interface always distinguishes computed facts from AI interpretation, with visible confidence and grounding status.

CSV, TSV, Excel, JSON, and Parquet file uploads, Google Sheets, and PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MSSQL databases. Multi-file and multi-table projects are first-class. Database connections should always use read-only credentials.

Every forecast runs out-of-sample back-tests across multiple folds. The model leaderboard shows MAPE, sMAPE, and skill vs. naive for each candidate. If a forecast cannot be validated, the system says so explicitly rather than fabricating confidence.

items.q: Does DAAS handle Arabic business data?
items.a: Yes. The Data Cleaning Agent detects and normalizes Arabic text — unifying alef variants, applying Unicode normalization, and handling mixed Arabic/Latin fields gracefully.

Important operations require explicit approval: relationship detection, cleaning plans, reconciliation issues, data saving, and AI-generated analysis actions. The product surfaces review checkpoints clearly and never silently commits consequential changes.

finalCta.body: Create your first project, connect your data, and let the agents do the heavy lifting — with your approval at every step.
